blocks.text: JUNK REMOVAL FAQ
Commercial Junk Removal in Etobicoke — What Clients Ask First

items.q: How much is commercial junk removal in Etobicoke?
a: Volume sets it: small junk pickups from $125, everything above scaling with the truck space your load fills. The exact figure is written free at your Etobicoke unit before anything moves, with labour, dismantling, elevator time and all disposal fees already inside — and it cannot rise afterward.

items.q: Can you work in buildings with freight elevators and dock rules?
a: Daily. We book elevator windows with building management, follow dock schedules, protect the common areas we pass through and carry the certificates of insurance most Etobicoke towers and complexes require. Tell us the building’s rules at booking and the crew arrives already compliant.

items.q: How fast can you clear a unit between tenants?
a: Usually within a day of the call. Trucks cover Etobicoke seven days a week, 6AM–11PM, so a morning walkthrough often becomes an afternoon clear-out — and for larger spaces we stage multiple trucks against your lease handover date. Call +1 647 922 5865 for today’s real availability.

items.q: Do you clear film and production studio spaces?
a: Yes — Etobicoke’s studio conversion wave made set, prop and staging removal a regular line of work. Wrapped production, closing studio or refit in progress, everything hauls at the same flat volume rates with scheduling built around your production calendar.

items.q: Will the junk removal disturb other tenants in the building?
a: It’s engineered not to. Service routes and freight elevators only, floors protected end to end, noise kept to working minimum, and timing set for the building’s quietest hours. Most neighbouring tenants learn we were there from the empty unit, not from us.

items.q: What happens to the junk after it leaves Etobicoke?
a: It gets sorted, deliberately: usable furniture and equipment to donation partners, metals, appliances and e-waste to licensed recyclers, landfill last and least. If your landlord, auditor or ESG report wants proof, we’ll document the breakdown.

items.q: Do you take recurring junk removal contracts from Etobicoke property managers?
a: They’re our core repeat business. Weekly, monthly or per-turnover schedules across whole portfolios, priced at the same volume rates every visit, consolidated to a single invoice with one contact who already knows each building’s rules.

items.q: Why do your junk removal quotes beat the national brands by 30–50%?
a: Because there’s no franchise royalty inside them. The big names route a cut of every Etobicoke job to head office; our independent structure doesn’t, so the identical load — same insurance, same care, same-day speed — simply costs less.
